business_problem: In today’s connected world, knowing who’s on the other side of a screen isn’t a luxury—it’s a requirement. Every online transaction, every new account sign-up, and every access request hinges on making sure that people are who they say they are.
solution_summary: In today’s connected world, knowing who’s on the other side of a screen isn’t a luxury—it’s a requirement. Every online transaction, every new account sign-up, and every access request hinges on making sure that people are who they say they are. One of Veriff’s most foundational ML models is responsible for detecting document specimens quickly and accurately. Before deploying this model, the process could take up to 2 weeks. Veriff reduced this time to less than a day by adopting multimodel endpoints for Amazon SageMaker, which provide a scalable and cost-effective solution for deploying large numbers of ML models. Amazon SageMaker has become a key tool for cost-effective model training, and engineers can deploy multiple ML models on AWS, facilitating rapid experimentation. Key services included Amazon SageMaker supports model training, tuning, deployment, or managed ml inference; Amazon Rekognition performs image or identity analysis inside verification workflows.

business_outcome: On AWS, Veriff has achieved further enhancements in its identity verification workflows, resulting in heightened efficiency and performance. With cost-effective ML and AI services, it has saved resources that it can invest in new projects, accelerating its speed of innovation. Thanks to this evolution, users benefit from a more seamless and reliable verification process, an advantage that will continue to improve.
